events.title: Opportunities in Agriculture
events.description: The Dickinson State University Department of Agriculture and Technical Studies initiated the Opportunities in Agriculture event because we want our students to be able to learn more about the agricultural industry in the region, network with the businesses/agencies in the region, and make connections for future opportunities after graduation (including graduate school). This event also serves as a forum for our seniors to present their senior capstone projects, which includes both an oral and poster presentation at the event. All DSU students, especially agriculture, natural sciences/environmental health, and business students, are invited to come to the event. This event is free and open to the public. We welcome and encourage the public to attend. The event consists of a keynote presentation, career fair, and senior capstone presentations.

events.title: Junie B. in Jingle Bells, Batman Smells!
events.description:
Blue Hawk Theatre Guild Presents

Junie B. Jones in Jingle Bells, Batman Smells! Get ready to kick off the holiday season with laughter, heart, and plenty of holiday cheer! Blue Hawk Theatre Guild, featuring Dickinson State University students alongside talented community members, proudly presents Junie B. Jones in Jingle Bells, Batman Smells!.

Junie B. Jones is excited about the holiday season and the Secret Santa gift exchange at school. But when she draws her class tattletale, May, as the recipient of her gift, Junie faces an important question: Will she embrace the true spirit of Christmas, kindness, and goodwill? Filled with hilarious moments, memorable characters, and an uplifting message, this family-friendly production is the perfect way to begin your holiday celebrations.

Join us Thanksgiving weekend for this festive theatrical tradition! Performance DatesFriday – Thanksgiving Weekend 7:00pm

Saturday – Thanksgiving Weekend 7:00pm

Sunday – Thanksgiving Weekend 2:00 pm

AdmissionAdults: $10

Students (K–12): $5

Free for Dickinson State University students, faculty, and staff with a valid DSU ID.

Bring the whole family and celebrate the season with Blue Hawk Theatre Guild as we share the joy, laughter, and heart of one of children's literature's most beloved characters!
